answer: Forging 175 of these means fabricating 175 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Proof comes from harbour master appointment record: an appointment the authority records across years of ports. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The voyage record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the dune entry is checkable by anyone, and the dawn window closes before a farm can catch up.
